### v3.0.1

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md; removed "核心教训" and other reflective text.
- Minor improvements to scripts/dameng_tool.py and scripts/knowledge_base_searcher.py for accuracy and consistency.
- No major feature additions or breaking changes.

Major rewrite and refactor: v3.0.0 removes stubs, consolidates key features, and ensures all core modules are fully functional.

- Core codebase refactored; 12 old scripts consolidated into 6 fully usable modules.
- Removed 6 redundant or stub scripts to improve reliability and real functionality.
- All known bugs fixed, including AttributeError issues and placeholder data sources.
- Major enhancements to dameng_tool (16 checks, tag search, test connect, SQL format) and unified code scanning/quality analysis.
- Upgraded knowledge search (Chinese segmentation, tag/semantic search, cache expiry) and added persistent model monitoring and prompt template management.
- Documentation and CLI commands updated to reflect the new, streamlined feature set.
